$comment: Phase 7 core setup state machine research defaults (not optimised). One setup model: liquidity sweep -> displacement MSS -> retracement into the leg's FVG. Any change must bump strategyVersion.

bias.$comment: Setup bias = the common direction of the last confirmed EXTERNAL BOS/MSS on every timeframe, as known at each candle's close.

$frequencyFlags: Enabled 2026-09-18 to let setups reach a confirmed plan. chaseGuardAfterTouchOnly defers the do-not-chase guard until the entry zone is touched; confirmBeforeChaseGuard lets a touched setup confirm on the same candle before the guard fires; minTargetAtr ignores micro-pools nearer than 1 ATR when picking the DOL target.
